title: Comprehensive analysis of the chromatin landscape in Drosophila melanogaster

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Comprehensive analysis of the chromatin landscape in Drosophila melanogaster》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Chromatin is composed of DNA and a variety of modified histones and non-histone proteins, which have an impact on cell differentiation, gene regulation and other key cellular processes.
